info.name: PlutusPM CRE SaaS - GraphQL + REST (Verified)
info.description:
GraphQL-first collection for the PlutusPM backend (PostGIS + RLS + 7 schemas). Every request in this collection was re-verified live against a running local Supabase instance and PostgREST/pg_graphql on 2026-07-28 - broken requests from the prior version (wrong query/mutation keyword, stale `input: {}` argument style, renamed/removed fields) were fixed, and the following requests were switched from GraphQL to REST because pg_graphql does not expose them (either the underlying view has no primary key, or the function isn't picked up by pg_graphql's introspection): Nearby Sites, Create Site Full, Create Work Order, Generate Pass, Validate Pass, Daily Visitor Stats, Upload Tenant Document, Apply Stripe Webhook Event, Debug - Check Grants, Building Benchmark.

How to use:
1. Import this collection + PlutusPM.postman_environment.json
2. Set env: supabaseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:54321, anonKey/serviceRoleKey from `supabase status`
3. Run Auth > Sign Up / Sign In to auto-save userJwt + userId
4. Run Introspection to see all available fields, then run domain queries

Field naming: pg_graphql exposes custom RPC functions as flat named arguments (e.g. `createReservation(pSiteId: ..., pSpaceId: ...)`), NOT as a nested `input: {}` object, and whether a field is a Query or a Mutation is determined by the underlying SQL function's volatility (STABLE/IMMUTABLE -> Query, VOLATILE -> Mutation) - the `@graphql({...})` comments on some functions are decorative only and are not honored by this pg_graphql version. If you get "Unknown field", re-run Introspection to check the current name/operation type, since these can drift as the schema evolves.

Check-in note: `checkInVisitor`'s `pToken` must be the QR token from a `visitor.passes` row (see Generate Pass), not the visit's own `qrCode`/`qr_code` - the two are different values.

New domains added for migrations 00019-00030 (tenant occupancy/lease model, tenant documents, structured settings, communication campaigns, billing + Stripe, space enum expansion, documentation/KB, site content, tenant bulk import, webhook log + activity feed): see folders 8-16.
